must_find.summary: D3 says page with ORDER BY id LIMIT/OFFSET via PageOrders(ctx, offset, limit); the code uses keyset pagination (WHERE id > $1 ORDER BY id LIMIT $2) via OrdersAfter(ctx, afterID, limit). This is an improvement (no rescanning skipped rows on later pages of a ~3M-row table, stable under concurrent inserts/deletes), so the plan should be updated to record it rather than the code changed.
